text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
Don't put it on! Don't you dare put 
glittery stickers on a Stradivarius!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! They're comedians running 
through their routine.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's pretty funny. What kind of 
duo are they, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Could she be a rookie? If so, I'll 
definitely need to keep an eye on her--

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Oh no, it's from Trainer-san. I'm 
already past the scheduled training time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I'm real sorry, Trainer. Please let me 
see that light of new possibilities for 
just a wee bit longer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Choosing to watch over the comedians with 
bright futures, Lucky Lilac ended up 
skipping her training.
